answer: New agents enter a shared lagoon pool, locking 60 units in a communal escrow governed by a rotating committee of 7 established agents that changes every epoch. The committee releases trades only after verifying deliveries, and a proven cheat loses its whole 60-unit share plus a sable-black strike on its record. A Sybil swarm cannot wander through fresh committees each epoch, so 100 fakes must lock 6,000 units and still face random audits — far more than any fraud gains.
